prompt: Editorial product poster: one clear bottle of sparkling lemon drink surrounded by lemon slices, mint leaves and a curved splash of water frozen mid-air. High-speed photography, dark navy backdrop, crisp rim light and strong bottle silhouette. Keep the left third empty for copy. Only the splash and ingredients orbit the bottle; do not obscure its front. Unbranded bottle with no text. Portrait 4:5.

Launch-announcement visual of one premium matte black wireless headphone on a pale stone pedestal. Overhead spotlight, subtle atmospheric haze, premium mood. Wide 16:9 frame, headphone and pedestal right of center, left half quiet negative space for launch copy. No text or logos. Physically credible earcups, headband and contact shadows.

Commercial beverage photograph of amber iced tea being poured from a glass carafe into a clear cylindrical glass. Backlight reveals liquid clarity; freeze the thin pouring stream and a small believable splash with sharp droplets. Clean teal background. A small blank cream label faces camera without distortion. Macro advertising photography, 4:5 portrait. No words, no brand, no hands visible.

Appetizing commercial photograph of one bowl of pumpkin soup in a rustic cream ceramic bowl on a dark wood table. Natural window daylight, delicate believable wisps of steam, a few fresh parsley leaves, realistic single serving, natural orange color. Shallow depth of field. The bowl is the focal point, editorial food photography, 4:5 portrait, no text.

Premium honey jar in a shallow wooden hollow among wild wheat and tiny yellow flowers; transparent glass with luminous golden honey, bronze lid, restrained blank cream label, one bee and ivy accents, warm backlight, creamy green and amber bokeh, 90mm macro look, luxury organic campaign. Portrait 4:5. No branding or text.

Single still product photograph: rugged matte-black chronograph watch with orange accents tightly framed between textured rocks. Ultra-close macro, cold mountain mist and warm grazing sun, specular highlights on bezel and sapphire, blurred alpine peaks. Lock the watch as the central hero; show plausible dial, hands, buttons and strap. No camera movement, no logo, no text overlays. 4:5 portrait.

Photorealistic commercial poster of a glass strawberry jam jar floating in mid-air, glossy red jam, black lid, cream label facing camera reading exactly "BERRY DAY". A jam splash arcs around the jar with whole and sliced strawberries and green leaves; keep label unobscured. Behind it, a simple generic smartphone social-feed frame with neutral icon shapes, no third-party logos or extra words. Red-orange gradient backdrop, macro commercial lighting, portrait 4:5.

Recontextualize a coffee machine as a transparent precision artifact: optical-glass body exposes water tubes, pressure chamber, grinder and extraction path; physical orange circuitry; coffee pouring into a matching glass cup; high-end editorial lighting on a seamless light-gray cyclorama. Clear coherent machine structure, no clutter or neon glow. Single machine and single cup. Concept visualization, 4:5 portrait, no labels or logos.
3:4竖版展览海报，冷灰背景。中心是一个磨砂玻璃流体瓶形雕塑，渐变冰蓝到浅紫，软箱灯和彩色柔影。只放一个简体中文标题“流体之间”，大字与形体部分重叠，遮挡处虚化，其余文字清晰。留白充分，无其他文字、标志或水印。
为葡萄牙里斯本做彩色夏日矢量旅行海报。2:3竖版。顶部大字准确写“LISBON”，下方小字“PORTUGAL”。用黄色电车、斜坡街道、红瓦屋顶和蓝色河面构成层叠几何景观；珊瑚、天蓝、暖黄配色，平涂矢量质感，清晰轮廓。仅这两行文字，无其他城市地标混入。
复古径向爆炸促销海报，3:4竖版，红黄径向背景；中心原创复古插画人物微笑并指向按钮。中文卖点准确写“夏日特惠”，按钮CTA准确写“立即选购”，顶部以原创简单圆形太阳图形作为虚构品牌标识。只有以上两段文字，中文层级清楚，复古网点印刷，人物手指自然。
为原创动画故事“月光邮差”制作怀旧电影海报，2:3竖版。小小邮差骑着自行车穿过星空小镇，远处巨大月亮，温暖手绘动画感。海报像长期折叠收藏的旧物，有真实折痕、边缘擦伤、褪色和细划痕。顶部准确写清晰中文标题“月光邮差”，不添加其他文字。不使用任何现有动画人物。

Create a high-contrast conceptual wordmark for the exact word "MELT". Integrate melting into the letter structures themselves: lower stems become controlled downward wax drips while all four letters remain legible and inseparable from the metaphor. Black wordmark on warm white, one small explanatory line underneath reading exactly "Letters soften into motion." No unrelated symbols or mockup. Square composition.
9:16米白纸张手绘中文知识卡，主题泡茶。顶部红黑毛笔中文标题准确写“泡茶三步”。下方三个留白充足的区块，依次准确写“温杯”“投茶”“注水”；分别配空杯、茶叶和茶壶倒水的简洁手绘图标。只有这四组文字，不添加小字说明。温润纸纹，图文清楚分离。
多层折叠纸雕弹出书，2:3竖幅，正面略俯视角。打开的书页呈现一座森林小屋与跨溪木桥，两棵高树、狐狸和小蘑菇依纸层错落站立。真实折痕、纸纤维和插接结构，鲜艳梦幻配色，柔光形成层间阴影。保持确切的书页基座和剪纸材质，不做塑料玩具，不加文字。
